# OpenUltraCode

OpenUltraCode adds nine slash commands, eight tools and ten agents to opencode 2. A command such as `/ultracode` starts a [Workflow](reference/glossary.md#term-workflow). The model records acceptance criteria, findings and the result of each check in a [Workflow record](reference/glossary.md#term-workflow-record). The [Completion gate](reference/glossary.md#term-completion-gate) then reports one status: `verified`, `partial`, `blocked`, `failed` or `research-only`.

OpenUltraCode keeps the model you selected in opencode. It runs no proxy and adds no model IDs.

This project is a fork of [norandom/OpenUltraCode](https://github.com/norandom/OpenUltraCode), which created it. The fork starts from upstream 2.0.1. [Completion gate](concepts/completion-gate.md) and [Session ownership](concepts/session-ownership.md) describe what it changes.

Start with [Install](start/install.md), then [Run a workflow](guides/run-a-workflow.md).
